name: Content View Bundle Permissions
description: Adds per-bundle permissions to filter the content admin view (listing) by node type.
project_description: Provides per-node-bundle permissions ('view any' / 'view own ... in content view') that filter which rows appear in the content admin View (the 'content' view, e.g. /admin/content) so each role sees only the bundles it is allowed to. Enforcement is via hook_views_query_alter plus an exposed-filter adjustment, scoped to the 'content' view; it does not implement node access grants and does not affect canonical node pages, JSON:API or REST. Requires PHP 8.1 and core Views and Node.
